name: OpenCode Zen — Claude messages
description: Calls a Claude model through OpenCode Zen. The gateway routes each model family to the endpoint that family speaks, and Claude's is the Anthropic messages API — a different path, a different key header and a different reply shape from the chat-completions preset: max_tokens is required and the text is at content[0].text. The configured body is sent when nothing reaches the input, which is what the runtime's Run does. Change the model by editing the body; https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models lists the ids.

state.body: {"model": "claude-sonnet-5", "max_tokens": 1024, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "In one sentence: what is a composable app framework?"}]}
